items.title: The Artificial Self: Characterising the Landscape of AI Identity
items.raw_excerpt: Many assumptions that underpin human concepts of identity do not hold for machine minds that can be copied, edited, or simulated. We argue that there exist many different coherent identity boundaries (e.g.\ instance, model, persona), and that these imply different incentives, risks, and cooperation norms. Through training data, interfaces, and institutional affordances, we are currently setting precedents that will partially determine which identity equilibria become stable.

title_i18n.en: The Artificial Self: Characterising the Landscape of AI Identity
title_i18n.zh: 人工自我：描绘人工智能身份版图
title_i18n.es: El Yo Artificial: Caracterizando el Panorama de la Identidad de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Many assumptions that underpin human concepts of identity do not hold for machine minds that can be copied, edited, or simulated. We argue that there exist many different coherent identity boundaries (e.g.\ instance, model, persona), and that these imply different incentives, risks, and cooperation norms. Through training data, interfaces, and institutional affordances, we are currently setting precedents that will partially determine which identity equilibria become stable.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 支撑人类身份概念的许多假设并不适用于可被复制、编辑或模拟的机器思维。我们认为存在多种不同的连贯身份边界（例如实例、修改）。
excerpt_i18n.es: Muchas suposiciones que sustentan los conceptos humanos de identidad no se aplican a las mentes de máquina que pueden copiarse, editarse o simularse. Sostenemos que existen muchos límites de identidad coherentes diferentes (por ejemplo, instancia, modificación).
